# vfx-hit

Two composed effects (`type vfx`, og.vfx) on a dark ground: a heavy hit
(`assets/fx/hit.ogt`: a flash, sparks bouncing off the ground, embers, dust,
a polar shock ring, a scorch decal, a burst of light and a shake, its
impact at 0.05 s) and a heal on a post (`assets/fx/heal.ogt`: a noise column,
two trails spiralling up it, rising motes, a sigil decal, a green light and
a flash when it resolves, event `healed` at 1.2 s). `hit` and `heal` spawn
them. The textures are generated by `textures.py` (rerun it to change them).

What it checks:

- `tests/hit.og.ts` (`og test tests/fixtures/vfx-hit`): each effect sends
  its event once, and one frame with the heal 1.1 s in and the hit 0.1 s in
  matches `references/metal/hit.png` (rmse ≤ 3).

Budget: under 10 s warm (measured 0.9 s of run warm, 3.1 s with its cook).
